segments.text: By reason of this knowledge, the Reprobate doeth giue consent, and in his heart subscribeth to the equitie of Gods law; as may appeare by the saying of Medea: Video meliora probóque; deteriora sequor. That is, I know what is best to be done, and like it; yet I doe the worst. This approbation in the Reprobate commeth from constraint; and is ioyned with a disliking of the lawe: in the elect being called, the approbation of the law, proceedeth from a willing and ready mind, and is ioyned with loue and liking.
